$description: Ten illustrations for the states of the interface. Decorative: hide them from screen readers (alt="" or aria-hidden). 720 by 720, transparent background.
license: CC BY 4.0, see LICENSE-DESIGN.md. The license is confirmed with the author in writing before 1.0.0.

illustrations.name: welcome
illustrations.label: Welcome
illustrations.use: First screen, onboarding, the first time after signing in.
illustrations.alt: An open door with a patch of light on the floor and a plant beside it

illustrations.name: empty
illustrations.label: Empty
illustrations.use: A list or a screen with nothing in it yet (the empty state).
illustrations.alt: An empty woven basket with a green leaf and dashed outlines of cassava roots above it

illustrations.name: loading
illustrations.label: Loading
illustrations.use: Loading: a short wait that ends on its own.
illustrations.alt: Coffee dripping through a strainer into a glass pot

illustrations.name: in-progress
illustrations.label: In progress
illustrations.use: Something is being processed and will take a while: an upload, an import, a payment.
illustrations.alt: A clay water filter on its stand, with a drop falling into a glass of water

illustrations.name: ready
illustrations.label: Ready
illustrations.use: It is done and waiting for you: an order, a report, a file ready to download.
illustrations.alt: A plate of rice, beans, steak, a fried egg, lettuce and tomato

illustrations.name: success
illustrations.label: Success
illustrations.use: An action that worked, a goal reached: a form sent, a payment made.
illustrations.alt: A soccer player in a blue number 9 shirt kneeling with both arms raised in front of the goal

illustrations.name: error
illustrations.label: Error
illustrations.use: An action that failed, a page that could not be loaded.
illustrations.alt: A broken clay pot with the crack mended in gold

illustrations.name: no-results
illustrations.label: No results
illustrations.use: A search or a filter that found nothing.
illustrations.alt: A flip-flop on a wave pattern, a magnifying glass and the dashed outline of the second flip-flop

illustrations.name: offline
illustrations.label: Offline
illustrations.use: No connection: what you did is kept and goes through when the network is back.
illustrations.alt: A yellow dog asleep curled up in a woven chair

illustrations.name: contact
illustrations.label: Contact
illustrations.alt: A blue public phone, with the handset hanging by its cord
